Every new root field now reports native_type_id and full SNBT value, with change_explained=false. Known first-manual stack explanation stays a separate narrow boolean; new progression values are not silently excused.

Eight new checks:2 noncanonical byte cases;2 new-manual unexpected-tag/caps cases;2 synthetic old-book custom-data-preserved cases;2 synthetic old-book custom-data-lost cases. Base16 retained, recorded total24.

coverage_limits: The actual historical input has4Int fields and12 stacks. The added old-book Tag/ForgeCaps fixtures deliberately modify an artificial copy; they validate comparator loss detection and are not proof that the real historical book contained those fields or that native remapping preserved them.

New root values are now disclosed, not classified automatically. An unexplained addition is a comparison result requiring investigation, not permission to delete content or a migration-failure conclusion by itself.
